description: This dataset contains observations of Lactuca graminifolia, a species of plant in the Asteraceae family, collected from various locations in the United States and Mexico. The data includes taxonomic information such as kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, and species, as well as spatial data like country code, state/province, decimal latitude, and decimal longitude. Temporal data includes event date, day, month, and year. The dataset also provides details on the observer, identification date, license, and media type. The semantic profile indicates that the data is structured for biodiversity research, with columns serving as aggregation keys, spatial filters, temporal filters, and quality control indicators. This dataset can be used for studying the distribution, habitat preferences, and temporal patterns of Lactuca graminifolia, as well as for biodiversity monitoring and conservation efforts.
